scope: Public primary-source descriptions, not firsthand playtesting or causal success/retention analysis. No code/art/price/timer copied.

sources.observed: Several skills unlock recipes and areas; restoration, fishing and home customization are parallel activities.
Management connects gathering, crafting, quests, other ventures and dungeon exploration.
Offline time, town requests, expansion, decoration and house activities coexist.
Skills supply other activities and practice opens ideas, recipes and tools; furnishing and cooperative cooking are described.

designInference: Independent capacities and different active/creative/social verbs alongside safe offline jobs; transparent ingredient/unlock chains and persistent visible expression.
implementationBoundary: 062implements only a finite non-economic sketchbook. Garden, services, public trophies, wardrobe and cooperative systems remain later staged slices.
